items.title: Jerry Blumberg Interview, 1961-04-06
items.q: he invited me up to spend the afternoons with him and take lessons or what have you... I was just trying to plumb the secrets of it somehow.

ctx.x: When he got to New York, the very first time he got there, he got out his horn too. And we got Mooney, George Lewis's wife's brother-in-law, who finally found out where his horn was and got it, and then they mailed it up there. Oh, yeah. Yeah, well... Go ahead with the rest of that engagement. I think that was 47, though.

Yeah, I remember the concert, and I remember being kind of disappointed, and you know, the funk just felt so bad, and so forth. But anyway, those were the lessons. I mean, he invited me up to spend the afternoons with him and take lessons or what have you, you know. And I'd come up to wherever he was, and usually he was in. Every now and then he'd be out someplace. I'd have to scout around the neighborhood and look in the corner drugstore or the neighborhood bar, wherever, try to figure out where he went off to,…
